title: The Guru shows wonders to the Sikhs

blocks.text: Water can spring forth from dry land, and without delay the Divine can kindle fire where none seemed possible.
If He so wills, rain can fall; even dry wood may seem to move like a river. (23)
He can turn the wind itself and reveal astonishing devices to the Sikhs without delay. (24)
